blocks.title: Isomerism
blocks.text: Do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula ek jaisa magar structural formulas aur khusoosiyat mukhtalif hon isomers hain, aur yeh mazhar isomerism hai. Structural formula compound mein atoms aur bonds ki tarteeb dikhata hai.

Structural isomers wala sab se saada hydrocarbon butane, C4H10, hai: butane aur oonche alkanes mein molecule ke atoms ek se zyada tarah tarteeb diye ja sakte hain jo sab valencies poori karein, to do ya zyada mukhtalif tarteebein ek molecular formula baant-ti hain. Chlorobutane ki do tarteebein hain, CH3CH2CH2CH2Cl (1-chlorobutane) aur CH3CHClCH2CH3 (2-chlorobutane), aur tajurba ek jaise formula C4H9Cl aur mukhtalif physical khusoosiyat wale do compounds ki tasdeeq karta hai. Teen se zyada carbon atoms wale compound mein isomerism aam hai, aur mumkin isomers ki tadaad carbons ki tadaad ke saath bohat tezi se barhti hai: pentane ke teen isomers hain.

blocks.prompt: Methane, ethane ya propane ka koi structural isomer kyun nahi, jabke butane ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek, do ya teen carbons ke saath carbons ko zanjeer mein jorne ka sirf ek tareeqa hai, to sirf ek structure valencies poori karta hai. Chaar carbons ke saath chautha teen carbon ki zanjeer ke sire se (butane) ya us ke darmiyani carbon se (2-methylpropane) jur sakta hai, formula C4H10 wale do mukhtalif compounds dete hue.

items: Isomers: ek molecular formula, mukhtalif structural formula aur khusoosiyat; pehle butane C4H10 mein; C4H9Cl mein 1- aur 2-chlorobutane; pentane ke teen isomers; tadaad carbon number ke saath tezi se barhti hai.
